name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 24 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 24 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
